scope: read-only current code and saved training events; no controller, learner update or runtime edit

confirmed_reporting_bug.cause: Per-batch MAE with empty terminal batches set to zero, then unweighted averaging by _MetricAccumulator. Ratio of summed terminal absolute errors to summed terminal counts is required. This changes reporting, not loss.

limitations: Training events are not the ten-trial greedy gate
Entropy floor prevents unconstrained temperature from reaching requested entropy, but is a deliberate experimental safeguard, not proven cause
Critic disagreement and rare terminal samples do not alone establish critic incorrectness
Frozen-Q actor-copy fit does not establish fit to a changing critic
Low argmax agreement can coexist with small Q regret; not independently a driving metric
